verdict.rationale: Lago has a dedicated API versioning page. It defines a v1 compatibility contract that tells clients to tolerate additive changes, and its endpoints are versioned under /api/v1. The pack does not show any explicit deprecation policy, such as notice periods, sunset timelines or how breaking changes are announced. missing for 10: documented deprecation policy and timelines, breaking-change and migration process, independent corroboration of version stability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: Clients should tolerate additive changes within v1, including new response fields, enum values, endpoints, optional request fields, and webhook event types.
